snippet.title: Scrap Mechanic - Physics & Wedge Update
snippet.description:
Hi Mechanics!
We’ve got a surprise update for you today
The “Physics and Wedge Update”!

While the next chapter is still in development, we didn’t want to hold back some exciting new features that could enhance your gameplay experience right away!

https://www.axolotgames.com

Music by Mitch Murder
